payload.name: PR Readiness Check
payload.description: 检查 PR 的评审就绪情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyzes supplied pull request materials for change evidence, requirement alignment, testing, risks, rollback, and readiness for human review. It does not access repositories, run tests, approve, or merge pull requests.
payload.longDescription: 分析提供的拉取请求材料，检查变更证据、需求匹配度、测试、风险、回滚方案，以及是否已准备好交由人工评审。它不会访问代码仓库、运行测试、批准或合并拉取请求。

payload.name: Prism by Crossdeck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prism reads your live Crossdeck workspace — revenue, entitlements, errors, analytics, read-cost and customer identity — joined BY IDENTITY, so it answers cross-layer questions no single-layer tool can: which paying customers an error hit and what they pay, who costs the most in database reads, and your lifetime-value leaderboard by name. Secure and read-only: OAuth 2.0 sign-in (no key to paste), no write path, and every number is self-describing (it reports 'not instrumented' rather than a fake zero for an un-wired surface).
payload.longDescription: Prism 可读取你实时的 Crossdeck 工作区——包括收入、权限、错误、分析数据、读取成本和客户身份——并按身份关联数据，因此能回答任何单层工具都无法回答的跨层问题：哪些付费客户遇到了某个错误以及他们支付了多少费用、哪些客户产生了最高的数据库读取成本，以及按姓名排列的客户生命周期价值排行榜。安全且只读：通过 OAuth 2.0 登录（无需粘贴密钥），没有写入功能；每个数字都附带自我说明（对于未接入的功能会报告“未埋点”，而不是伪造零值）。

payload.name: mittwald
payload.description: 管理 mittwald 托管服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. List and inspect projects, apps, servers and domains; provision and manage MySQL and Redis databases, users, backups and backup schedules; work with containers, stacks, cron jobs and volumes; configure domains, DNS zones, virtual hosts, SSL certificates and mail addresses; manage organization and project members, SSH users and keys, and API tokens. Read-only tools inspect resources, while write tools create, update or remove them on the authenticated user's behalf.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 管理你的 mittwald（mStudio）托管基础设施。列出并检查项目、应用、服务器和域名；配置和管理 MySQL 与 Redis 数据库、用户、备份及备份计划；管理容器、技术栈、cron 作业和卷；配置域名、DNS 区域、虚拟主机、SSL 证书和邮件地址；管理组织和项目成员、SSH 用户和密钥，以及 API 令牌。只读工具用于检查资源，写入工具则会代表已验证身份的用户创建、更新或删除资源。

payload.name: Flyte
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Author, run, and deploy Flyte 2 workflows, apps, and agents with skills grounded in the Flyte SDK and documentation. In ChatGPT web, search Flyte docs and SDK examples. In a local ChatGPT environment with the Flyte CLI configured, run and manage your authenticated Flyte cluster.
payload.longDescription: 基于 Flyte SDK 和文档中的技能，编写、运行和部署 Flyte 2 工作流、应用和代理。在 ChatGPT 网页版中搜索 Flyte 文档和 SDK 示例。在已配置 Flyte CLI 的本地 ChatGPT 环境中，运行并管理经过身份验证的 Flyte 集群。

payload.name: Lumen UI
payload.description: 使用 Lumen 构建界面
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lumen UI helps coding agents build accessible interfaces from a real multi-framework design-system contract. Search the component catalog, retrieve framework-specific usage and source, inspect web and native recipes, read semantic tokens, and follow the bundled Lumen workflow for Astro, React, Web Components, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.
payload.longDescription: Lumen UI 帮助编程智能体依据实际的多框架设计系统规范，构建无障碍界面。搜索组件目录，获取特定框架的用法和源代码，查看 Web 与原生应用的实现示例，读取语义化设计变量，并遵循随附的 Lumen 工作流，适用于 Astro、React、Web Components、React Native、SwiftUI 和 Jetpack Compose。

payload.name: Resolve AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.
payload.longDescription:
该插件生产环境 AI。以下功能和限制适用：
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.

payload.name: HTML/CSS to Image API
payload.description: HTML 转图片及网址截图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.

Use it to:

- Render HTML and CSS into PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF
- Capture screenshots of public URLs
- Generate images from reusable templates and variables
- Create batches of multiple image variations
- Create, update, list, and version image templates
- Configure viewport size, device scale, selectors, render delays, and other rendering options
payload.longDescription:
HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器让 AI 助手通过自然语言指令创建可用于生产环境的图像、网站截图和 PDF。

可用于：

- 将 HTML 和 CSS 渲染为 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 PDF
- 截取公开网址的屏幕截图
- 使用可复用模板和变量生成图像
- 批量创建多个图像变体
- 创建、更新、列出图像模板并管理其版本
- 配置视口尺寸、设备缩放比例、选择器、渲染延迟及其他渲染选项

payload.name: HOME AI Node
payload.description: 节点健康状况与任务状态
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress. In this phase the server is backed by a deterministic synthetic review fixture (node review-demo-node) so reviewers can exercise every tool without any private network access; connection to a real HOME AI node is a later phase behind an authorized-user boundary (OAuth). All operations are strictly read-only: nothing on this server can write, execute, or reach any private network.
payload.longDescription: HOME AI Node 可让 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的健康状况、运行状态和跟踪任务。get_node_status 会报告节点是否在线及其仓库状态；get_runtime_state 会显示运行模式和 MCP 协议；get_task_status 会查询任务进度。在此阶段，服务器使用确定性的合成审查样例（节点 review-demo-node），供审查者在不访问任何专用网络的情况下测试所有工具。连接真实 HOME AI 节点属于后续阶段，并须通过授权用户边界（OAuth）。所有操作都严格只读：此服务器不能写入、执行操作或访问任何专用网络。

payload.name: Knock
payload.description: 跨渠道向用户发送消息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

Inspect workflows and manage notifications, directly in ChatGPT and Codex.
payload.longDescription:
Knock 是面向代理优先的产品、营销和事务性消息客户互动基础设施。通过一个平台管理电子邮件、短信、推送、聊天和应用内消息。

直接在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中检查工作流并管理通知。

payload.name: Suger
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Suger helps marketplace teams work with cloud marketplace, CRM, co-sell, integration, billing, and knowledge data in ChatGPT. Users can look up offers, buyers, entitlements, referrals, integrations, workflow runs, CRM records, and support knowledge, and perform enabled actions through their connected Suger organization.
payload.longDescription: Suger 帮助市场团队在 ChatGPT 中处理云市场、CRM、联合销售、集成、账单和知识数据。用户可以查询优惠、买家、授权权益、推荐、集成、工作流运行记录、CRM 记录和支持知识，并通过已连接的 Suger 组织执行已启用的操作。

payload.name: Uizze
payload.description: 打造出众的 UI 设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Uizze gives coding agents a free anti-ui-slop Skill and optional full MCP access to live UI references, license-clear materials, and rendered safety checks. Use the skill to inspect the product and design system, write a design contract, cover required states, and run a bounded finish gate. The MCP answers one concrete unresolved UI question with strong full-screen references, finds license-clear materials for a concrete role, or optionally checks rendered UI for observable breakage, accessibility, privacy, and task-blocking composition. The free preview MCP exposes a deterministic source check only.
payload.longDescription: Uizze 为编程智能体提供免费的反 UI 套模板 Skill，并可选完整 MCP 访问权限，以查看实时 UI 参考、许可清晰的素材和渲染后的安全检查结果。使用该 Skill 检查产品和设计系统、编写设计约定、覆盖必需状态，并运行范围明确的收尾检查。MCP 可以针对一个具体且尚未解决的 UI 问题提供有力的全屏参考，为具体角色查找许可清晰的素材，或按需检查渲染后的 UI 是否存在可观察到的故障、无障碍问题、隐私问题以及妨碍任务完成的布局。免费预览版 MCP 仅提供确定性的源代码检查。

payload.name: TALON Knowledge
payload.description: 搜索 TALON 手册和问答
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence. Typical uses include feature design consultation, configuration value lookups, error-cause investigation, browsing similar real-world examples, and automated validation of generated settings.

A TALON maintenance contract and a TALON support site (Zendesk) account are required. Users authenticate by signing in to the support site when connecting. All tools are read-only, and users' conversation content, code, and attachments are never sent to our servers (details: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy).
payload.longDescription:
此连接器可让 AI 智能体搜索 TALON 的官方知识库。TALON 是一个用于构建业务应用的低代码平台。它会搜索数千页官方手册、支持问答、包含 900+ 个真实功能配置示例的数据库以及规范分析，并返回带来源 URL 的答案作为依据。典型用途包括功能设计咨询、查询配置值、调查错误原因、浏览相似真实案例，以及自动验证生成的设置。

需要 TALON 维护合同和 TALON 支持网站（Zendesk）账户。连接时，用户需登录支持网站完成身份验证。所有工具均为只读，用户的对话内容、代码和附件绝不会发送到我们的服务器（详情：https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy）。

payload.name: Craftian
payload.description: 创建完整可用的 Web 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create fully working business software and web apps from a prompt. With Craftian you can create CRMs, task managers, inventory systems, expense trackers, time trackers, job portals, on-boarding portals, data forms etc.

Craftian creates production-ready web apps with built-in database, authentication, role-based access control, file storage, and automatic cloud deployment.

No coding experience required. Just describe what you want, and keep refining it.
payload.longDescription:
根据提示创建完整可用的商业软件和 Web 应用。使用 Craftian，您可以创建 CRM、任务管理器、库存系统、费用跟踪器、时间跟踪器、招聘门户、入职门户、数据表单等。

Craftian 创建可用于生产环境的 Web 应用，内置数据库、身份验证、基于角色的访问控制、文件存储和自动云部署。

无需编码经验。只需描述想要的内容，并持续完善。

payload.name: FluxBuilder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to the FluxBuilder MCP server to manage native Flutter app projects for WooCommerce, Shopify, and WordPress. Easily create apps, redesign screens, update settings, search store catalogs, capture mobile previews, and run test or release builds for the App Store, Google Play, and web—all without writing code.
payload.longDescription: 连接 FluxBuilder MCP 服务器，以管理 WooCommerce、Shopify 和 WordPress 的原生 Flutter 应用项目。无需编写代码，即可轻松创建应用、重新设计屏幕、更新设置、搜索商店目录、捕获移动端预览，并为 App Store、Google Play 和 Web 运行测试版或发布版构建。

payload.name: Sleuth Skills
payload.description: 在聊天中使用自定义技能
payload.summaryOriginal: Use your custom skills in chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sleuth Skills connects ChatGPT to your personal skills.new vault — a private collection of skills, rules, agents, and slash commands you've authored or saved. The app lets ChatGPT discover what's in your vault and load the full content of a specific skill on demand, so conversations can follow your own playbooks instead of relying on generic knowledge. It is read-only: it never modifies, deletes, or shares your vault content.
payload.longDescription: Sleuth Skills 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人 skills.new 知识库——其中私密收藏着你创建或保存的技能、规则、智能体和斜杠命令。该应用可让 ChatGPT 发现知识库中的内容，并按需加载特定技能的完整内容，让对话遵循你自己的工作方法，而不是依赖通用知识。它是只读的：绝不会修改、删除或分享你的知识库内容。

payload.name: Dependency Upgrade Plan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Creates evidence-based dependency upgrade preparation plans from supplied release, usage, testing, and rollback materials. It does not modify repositories, execute upgrades, run tests, commit changes, or create pull requests.
payload.longDescription: 根据提供的版本发布、使用、测试和回滚材料，制定有依据的依赖项升级准备计划。它不会修改代码仓库、执行升级、运行测试、提交更改或创建拉取请求。

payload.name: EzzyBills
payload.description: 使用 EzzyBills API 构建应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the authoritative EzzyBills developer specification, REST API contracts, authentication models, and integration guidance for building EzzyBills applications such as approval dashboards, email response workflows, and purchase order tools.
payload.longDescription: 获取权威的 EzzyBills 开发者规范、REST API 合约、身份验证模型和集成指南，用于构建 EzzyBills 应用，例如审批仪表板、邮件回复工作流和采购订单工具。

payload.name: Control Plane
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Build a GitHub or a GitLab repo into a container and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, give it a custom domain, attach Postgres or Redis, and let it autoscale. Diagnose failures from logs, metrics, and events, and find the over-provisioned workloads inflating your cloud bill.
payload.longDescription: Control Plane 可在 AWS、GCP、Azure、Oracle Cloud 和自有硬件上，将容器化应用作为一个平台运行。将 GitHub 或 GitLab 仓库构建为容器并部署到可公开访问的 HTTPS URL，配置自定义域名、连接 Postgres 或 Redis，并启用自动扩缩容。还可根据日志、指标和事件诊断故障，并找出推高云账单的过度配置工作负载。

payload.name: Birdie
payload.description: 捕捉客户问题的上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.
payload.longDescription:
Birdie 帮助你捕捉客户问题，并转化为清晰的故障排查上下文。

客户可以录制屏幕展示问题，无需只依赖文字描述。Birdie 捕捉完整上下文，包括发生了什么、点击了什么，以及控制台日志、网络请求、会话数据、设备元数据和复现步骤等技术证据。

这些信息为智能体提供理解问题、准确排查并更快解决问题所需的上下文。

使用 Birdie，智能体无需猜测客户的意思。它可以看到客户所看到的内容，并用合适的证据调查问题。

Birdie 专为支持和技术团队打造，减少反复沟通，帮助人类和 AI 更快排查客户问题。

payload.name: Test Failure Triage
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn supplied test output into a clear failure list, evidence-based classifications, and an investigation order. The plugin works only from the information you provide and does not access code, CI systems, repositories, or external services.
payload.longDescription: 将提供的测试输出整理成清晰的失败清单、基于证据的分类和调查顺序。此插件仅依据你提供的信息工作，不会访问代码、CI 系统、代码库或外部服务。

payload.name: BitsWeave
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.

Sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT can search and hydrate your org context so you do not repeat who you are, what the project is, or what you already decided.

What you can do:
• Look up a specific fact about your company, a past decision, or a current task.
• Ask a synthesis question across decisions, notes, and related records.
• Create or update a Bitsweave record from the conversation when you want the result stored.

Connect GitHub, email, and other tools through Bitsweave brokers when you enable them. Claude calls Bitsweave. Bitsweave uses the permissions you granted. The agent does not hold the upstream credentials.

Sign-in is required. The connector URL is https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp.

Setup: add Bitsweave, complete the OAuth sign-in, then ask ChatGPT to search your context or create a record. Public docs: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents
payload.longDescription:
Bitsweave 是由用户拥有的 AI 工具上下文层。它存储组织的结构化工作内容，通过上下文图谱关联这些内容，并通过 MCP 向 Claude 提供访问。

使用 OAuth 登录。ChatGPT 可以搜索并加载你的组织上下文，让你不必重复说明自己的身份、项目内容或已经做出的决定。

你可以：
• 查询关于公司、过去决定或当前任务的具体事实。
• 跨决定、笔记和相关记录提出综合性问题。
• 希望保存结果时，根据对话创建或更新 Bitsweave 记录。

启用后，通过 Bitsweave 代理连接 GitHub、电子邮件及其他工具。Claude 调用 Bitsweave，Bitsweave 使用你授予的权限。智能体不持有上游服务的凭据。

需要登录。连接器 URL 为 https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp。

设置：添加 Bitsweave，完成 OAuth 登录，然后让 ChatGPT 搜索你的上下文或创建记录。公开文档：https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents

payload.name: Prefect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Prefect Cloud to inspect workflows, diagnose failed, late, or stuck runs, review workspace and worker health, and search current Prefect documentation and release notes. The hosted tools are read-only.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Prefect Cloud，检查工作流、诊断失败、延迟或卡住的运行，查看工作区和工作进程的健康状况，并搜索最新的 Prefect 文档和发行说明。托管工具均为只读。

payload.name: Vynix
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vynix MCP brings visual website feedback into ChatGPT so teams can fix issues with full context instead of guesswork. It lets ChatGPT access projects, annotations, comments, screenshots, and AI diagnosis data, then help you prioritize, investigate, and resolve work quickly. Teams can update annotation status, add comments, create GitHub issues, and generate share links from one workflow.

Built for product, engineering, and QA teams, Vynix MCP reduces back-and-forth by connecting discussion and implementation in one place.
payload.longDescription:
Vynix MCP 将网站视觉反馈引入 ChatGPT，让团队能够基于完整上下文排查问题，而不必猜测。它让 ChatGPT 访问项目、标注、评论、截图和 AI 诊断数据，进而帮助你快速安排优先级、调查并解决问题。团队可以在一个工作流中更新标注状态、添加评论、创建 GitHub 问题并生成分享链接。

Vynix MCP 专为产品、工程和 QA 团队打造，通过将讨论与实施衔接起来，减少来回沟通。

payload.name: NeuronSearchLab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inspect and manage your NeuronSearchLab recommendation workspace from ChatGPT. Search catalogue items, understand rankings, configure contexts, pipelines, rules and segments, run experiments and model training, and review performance analytics.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中查看并管理你的 NeuronSearchLab 推荐工作区。搜索目录条目、了解排名、配置上下文、流水线、规则和细分群体、运行实验和模型训练，并查看效果分析。

payload.name: Extend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parse, extract, classify, and split documents from chat: pull fields, tables, and line items out of PDFs, images, Office files, and spreadsheets, identify document types, break bundles into separate documents, and fill PDF forms. Build and test reusable extractors, classifiers, and workflows on real documents, then run them at scale in your Extend workspace.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天中解析、提取、分类和拆分文档：从 PDF、图像、Office 文件和电子表格中提取字段、表格和明细项，识别文档类型，将文件包拆分为独立文档，并填写 PDF 表单。在真实文档上构建并测试可复用的提取器、分类器和工作流，然后在 Extend 工作区中大规模运行。

payload.name: Relewise Developer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, review, and troubleshoot Relewise Search, Recommendations, behavioral tracking, and data integrations with current API and SDK guidance for C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, and Java.
payload.longDescription: 根据适用于 C#、TypeScript/JavaScript、PHP 和 Java 的最新 API 与 SDK 指南，构建、审查并排查 Relewise 搜索、推荐、行为跟踪和数据集成问题。

payload.name: MCP Conduct Register
payload.description: 检查 MCP 服务器行为
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.
payload.longDescription:
此插件展示 MCP 服务器已测量行为的公开登记信息。

系统会按计划测量五项条件：服务器是否使用 MCP、是否发布 A2A 智能体卡、是否声明由谁付费、相同输入是否返回相同输出，以及第三方能否重新计算判断结果。无法测量的条件会记录为“未测量”，绝不会计为通过，登记方运营者也不能放宽此规则。

登记册不会对服务器排名，也不会推荐某台服务器优于另一台。它会返回已测量的内容、测量时间和记录的 SHA-256 值，让不信任发布方的人也能自行核验。

未出现在登记册中的端点，只表示从未在此处测量。缺失会如实报告为缺失，不代表负面判断。

除非被检查服务器的所有者已记录同意，否则不会测量确定性，因为这需要在他人的服务器上执行工具。

免费、只读、无需账户或密钥。登记册是由定时脚本生成的构建产物，不经过编辑环节，并以 DOI 归档，确保即使代码仓库迁移，引用仍然有效。

payload.name: Kody
payload.description: 将智能体的工作转化为软件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections. Credentials remain server-side, installed community packages are forked into the user's account, and saved workflows can run later without another model call. The same user-owned artifacts remain available across MCP-capable agents.
payload.longDescription: Kody 可将你在 ChatGPT 中取得的成果转化为持久、由你拥有的软件。ChatGPT 可以借助 Kody 查找你可用的能力，并将有效方案转化为可重复使用的软件包、计划、webhook、可移植记忆以及由密钥支持的连接。凭据保留在服务器端；安装的社区软件包会分叉到你的账户中；保存的工作流日后运行时无需再次调用模型。同一批由用户拥有的成果也可供支持 MCP 的智能体使用。

payload.name: MijnSpel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MijnSpel helps board game designers create and refine playable prototypes in Creator or Studio, validate project files, preview gameplay, run balance simulations, compare results, and publish a confirmed project to the web.
payload.longDescription: MijnSpel 帮助桌游设计师在 Creator 或 Studio 中创建并完善可玩的原型、验证项目文件、预览玩法、运行平衡性模拟、比较结果，并将确认后的项目发布到网上。

payload.name: Stem
payload.description: 让你的 AI 共享一个大脑。
payload.summaryOriginal: Connect your AI to one brain.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and ChatGPT can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and see it all visualized at awase.dev/stem. The same memory is available to every MCP-compatible tool the user connects, so context never has to be re-explained. Free tier included; storage tiers are opt-in.
payload.longDescription: Stem 是一种跨 AI 的持久记忆。连接一次后，ChatGPT 就可以存储提炼后的记忆（决策、事实、偏好、项目背景），在未来任何聊天中回忆最相关的内容，将相关想法关联成带类型的知识图谱，并通过 awase.dev/stem 查看可视化结果。用户连接的每个兼容 MCP 的工具都能使用同一份记忆，因此无需反复解释背景。包含免费层级；存储层级可选择启用。

payload.name: QA Wolf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to QA Wolf to inspect authorized workspaces, explore a staging app in a cloud browser, request test implementation from QA Wolf AI, run existing tests and review results. Follow live session links and verify validation, publication and draft or active readiness separately. Tools also manage test configuration, flow tags, issues, scheduled or deployment triggers, and workspace test email. A QA Wolf account with the required workspace permissions is needed. Runner and AI work can incur charges, and test actions can change the application under test. Connected integrations can publish code or send messages.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 QA Wolf，以检查获授权的工作区、在云浏览器中探索暂存应用、请求 QA Wolf AI 编写测试实现、运行现有测试并查看结果。通过实时会话链接，分别验证校验、发布以及草稿或正式运行状态。工具还可管理测试配置、流程标签、问题、定时或部署触发器，以及工作区测试邮箱。需要拥有具备所需工作区权限的 QA Wolf 账户。运行器和 AI 工作可能产生费用，测试操作也可能更改被测应用。已连接的集成可能发布代码或发送消息。

payload.name: Hyperhuman Agent Workspace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with Hyperhuman fitness content directly in ChatGPT. Explore sample workouts, review structured workout data, inspect exercise flows and media, and generate copy-ready API or embed snippets for web and mobile apps. Sign in with Hyperhuman Teams to browse your workspace content, manage workouts, programs, exercises, and social drops, and run selected content workflows through chat.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 Hyperhuman 健身内容。探索示例训练，查看结构化训练数据，检查动作流程和媒体，并生成可直接用于 Web 和移动应用的 API 或嵌入代码片段。使用 Hyperhuman Teams 登录后，可浏览工作区内容、管理训练、计划、动作和社交动态，并通过聊天执行选定的内容工作流。

payload.name: Panderr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring an existing website into Panderr to preserve, improve, or redesign it. Start with the website you already have, migrate its pages and content, then continue editing and managing the site in Panderr.
payload.longDescription: 将现有网站导入 Panderr，以便保留、改进或重新设计。以现有网站为起点，迁移其页面和内容，然后继续在 Panderr 中编辑和管理网站。

payload.name: FreakUI
payload.description: 使用 FreakUI 构建原生 Apple 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build a single-target, multi-platform native Swift application for iPhone, iPad, and macOS from one prompt. FreakUI establishes a robust clean architecture foundation with dependency injection, programmatic navigation, MVVM, and platform-specific root views. Its custom theme initialization, precision-focused components, utilities, and extensions give the interface a distinct and consistent identity. Beyond project creation, dedicated FreakUI skills help shape interface sections, add components, and evolve the interface as the app grows.
payload.longDescription: 只需一个提示，即可构建适用于 iPhone、iPad 和 macOS 的单一目标多平台原生 Swift 应用。FreakUI 会建立稳健、整洁的架构基础，包括依赖注入、程序化导航、MVVM 和针对不同平台的根视图。自定义主题初始化、注重精度的组件、实用工具和扩展让界面拥有鲜明且一致的风格。除了创建项目，专门的 FreakUI 技能还可以帮助设计界面各部分、添加组件，并随着应用的发展不断完善界面。

payload.name: Watchgoose
payload.description: 监控 cron 和周期性任务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Watchgoose helps developers monitor cron jobs, backups, Kubernetes jobs, and recurring scripts. Connect one Watchgoose project to inspect checks, schedules, retained status changes, recent signals, and integration names. 

With explicit read-and-write consent, users can create, update, pause, resume, and delete checks. Read-only access is the default.
payload.longDescription:
Watchgoose 帮助开发者监控 cron 作业、备份、Kubernetes 作业和周期性脚本。连接一个 Watchgoose 项目，即可查看检查项、计划安排、保留的状态变更、近期信号和集成名称。

在明确同意读写权限后，用户可以创建、更新、暂停、恢复和删除检查项。默认权限为只读。

payload.name: BranchDeploy
payload.description: 部署 Azure DevOps 工作项
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

Preview a work item deployment, confirm the resolved ticket, branch, environment and pipeline, then queue the deployment only if BranchDeploy’s server-side rules allow it.

BranchDeploy does not let ChatGPT deploy arbitrary code. It resolves linked Azure Repos branches and pull requests from the work item, checks the configured environment and branch rules, and requires explicit confirmation before a deployment starts.

Use it to:
- Preview what branch and environment a work item will deploy to
- Confirm the deployment before anything runs
- Queue your existing Azure Pipeline
- Check deployment status
- View recent deployment history
- List configured deployment environments

BranchDeploy wraps your existing Azure Pipeline setup. No YAML changes are required, and deployment safety is enforced server-side using your configured project, environment and branch rules.
payload.longDescription:
BranchDeploy 将 ChatGPT 连接到你现有的 Azure DevOps 部署工作流。

预览工作项部署，确认解析出的工单、分支、环境和管道；只有 BranchDeploy 的服务器端规则允许时，才会将部署加入队列。

BranchDeploy 不允许 ChatGPT 部署任意代码。它会根据工作项解析关联的 Azure Repos 分支和拉取请求，检查已配置的环境和分支规则，并要求明确确认后才会开始部署。

可用于：
- 预览工作项将部署到哪个分支和环境
- 在任何操作运行前确认部署
- 将现有 Azure Pipeline 加入队列
- 检查部署状态
- 查看近期部署历史
- 列出已配置的部署环境

BranchDeploy 封装你现有的 Azure Pipeline 配置。无需更改 YAML；部署安全由服务器端根据你配置的项目、环境和分支规则强制执行。

payload.name: ShareThis AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ShareThis AI for ChatGPT makes social sharing simpler and free for everyone. Connect your ShareThis account to manage apps, properties, and sharing insights directly within ChatGPT. Access powerful tools for website publishers including Inline Share Buttons, Sticky Share Buttons, GDPR CMP, Privacy Policy Generator, Follow Buttons, Reaction Buttons, Image Share Buttons, and Video Share Buttons.
payload.longDescription: ShareThis AI for ChatGPT 让每个人都能更轻松、免费地分享社交内容。连接 ShareThis 账户后，可直接在 ChatGPT 中管理应用、站点资源和分享数据洞察。网站发布者还可使用强大工具，包括 Inline Share Buttons、Sticky Share Buttons、GDPR CMP、Privacy Policy Generator、Follow Buttons、Reaction Buttons、Image Share Buttons 和 Video Share Buttons。

payload.name: Montra
payload.description: 向智能体展示要更改的内容
payload.summaryOriginal: Show your agent what to change
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Montra turns screenshots and screen recordings into agent ready tasks with the right visual context attached. Share them with your team, send them to tools like ChatGPT and Codex, or automatically create tickets in your issue tracker of choice in a few clicks.
payload.longDescription: Montra 会将屏幕截图和录屏转换成带有适当视觉上下文的智能体就绪任务。你可以与团队分享，发送到 ChatGPT 和 Codex 等工具，或只需点击几下，自动在你选择的问题跟踪器中创建工单。

payload.name: Coval
payload.description: 评估语音和聊天智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.
payload.longDescription: Coval 帮助团队检查 AI 智能体、测试集、角色设定、指标和评估运行；创建并完善评估资源、启动评估，并向 Sofia 咨询基于其 Coval 组织数据的只读分析。

payload.name: RideDesk
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur,
  taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs
  each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under
  their own brand.

  This plugin serves RideDesk's developer documentation as queryable tools,
  so an agent can pull the exact API contract while building an operator's
  booking website: the three-call quote → book → checkout flow, embeddable
  booking widgets, visitor attribution, live chat, the customer portal, and
  each account's own MCP booking server for AI-agent bookings.

  It is read-only and requires no account or authentication. Actual quotes
  and bookings happen on an operator's own domain, never through this
  plugin — and prices are always computed server-side from the operator's
  own rate card, never by an agent.

  Typical uses: ask for the integration brief before building a booking
  site, look up the checkout contract, fetch widget embed snippets for a
  specific domain, or search the docs for captcha, attribution and
  customer-portal details.
payload.longDescription:
RideDesk 是机场接送、专车、出租车和车辆租赁运营商使用的预订与调度软件，按运营商自己的品牌管理预订、报价、司机、开票和付款。此插件将 RideDesk

开发者文档作为可查询工具，让代理在构建运营商预订网站时获取准确 API 合同，包括三次调用的“报价 → 预订 → 结账”流程、可嵌入预订组件、访客归因、实时聊天、

客户门户及每个账户自己的 MCP 预订服务器。它是只读的，无需账户或身份验证。实际报价和预订发生在运营商自己的域名上，绝不会通过此插件完成；价格始终由服务器根据

运营商自己的费率表计算，而不是由代理计算。典型用途包括构建预订网站前获取集成简报、查询结账合同、获取指定域名的组件嵌入代码片段，或搜索验证码、归因和客户门户详情。

payload.name: GEO Tool Check
payload.description: 评估 AI 搜索技术表现
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GEO Tool Check helps users assess whether a public page can be read, understood, and cited by AI search systems. It scores page readiness, checks whether major AI crawlers are blocked, and evaluates draft passages for citability. Checks run without an account or API key and use the same scoring logic as geo-tool.com.
payload.longDescription: GEO Tool Check 可帮助用户评估 AI 搜索系统能否读取、理解并引用公开页面。它会为页面准备度评分，检查主要 AI 爬虫是否遭到屏蔽，并评估草稿段落是否适合引用。检查无需账户或 API 密钥，并使用与 geo-tool.com 相同的评分逻辑。

payload.name: Smooth Bundle
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to Smooth Bundle to manage CDN projects and assets. List projects, inspect asset metadata, upload files, delete assets with confirmation, purge stale asset records, and review usage through your Smooth Bundle account.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Smooth Bundle，以管理 CDN 项目和资产。列出项目、检查资产元数据、上传文件、经确认后删除资产、清理过时的资产记录，并通过你的 Smooth Bundle 账户查看用量。

payload.name: Replay.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Time travel debugging
payload.longDescription: 时光回溯调试

payload.name: Upstash Redis
payload.description: Redis 及其他 Upstash 产品
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Upstash resources from ChatGPT through the hosted Upstash MCP server (OAuth on first use): create and inspect Redis databases and run commands on them, publish QStash messages and manage schedules, build Vector and Search indexes, and drive Box sandboxes and Blob storage. Credentials stay on the server and are returned only when you ask for them.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的 Upstash MCP 服务器（首次使用时通过 OAuth 授权），在 ChatGPT 中管理你的 Upstash 资源：创建并检查 Redis 数据库、在数据库上运行命令、发布 QStash 消息并管理计划任务、构建 Vector 和 Search 索引，以及使用 Box 沙盒和 Blob 存储。凭据保留在服务器上，只有在你主动索取时才会返回。

payload.name: BrowserStack
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage test cases, execute manual or automated tests, debug failures, and get suggested fixes.

Test from any AI tool: Connect the BrowserStack Test Platform to what you already such as IDEs, LLMs, or agentic workflows

Test with natural language: Create test cases and runs, launch sessions on real browsers and devices, run accessibility and visual checks, pull failure logs, and get AI root cause analysis, all from plain English prompts.

Less context switching: Keep all project context in one place and trigger actions directly from your IDE or LLM.
payload.longDescription:
管理测试用例、执行手动或自动化测试、调试故障并获取建议修复方案。

使用任意 AI 工具进行测试：将 BrowserStack Test Platform 连接到你已有的工具，例如 IDE、大语言模型或智能体工作流。

用自然语言测试：创建测试用例和测试运行，在真实浏览器和设备上启动会话，执行无障碍和视觉检查，提取故障日志，并通过简单的英文提示获取 AI 根因分析。

减少上下文切换：将所有项目上下文集中在一处，并直接从 IDE 或大语言模型触发操作。

payload.name: DB Fiddle
payload.description: 不离开聊天即可运行 SQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The DB Fiddle plugin lets users run SQL against a disposable sandbox environment, directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Create database schemas, load sample data, execute queries, and inspect real database results without connecting to a production database or external system.

The sandbox provides the perfect place for ChatGPT and Codex to iterate on queries and safely debug SQL, reproduce database issues, validate queries and experiment with any of the supported database engines.

Supported database engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and more.

Note: A db-fiddle.com PRO subscription is required to use this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
DB Fiddle 插件让用户可直接通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex，在一次性沙盒环境中运行 SQL。

创建数据库架构、加载示例数据、执行查询并查看真实数据库结果，无需连接生产数据库或外部系统。

沙盒为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 提供了理想环境，可反复调整查询并安全地调试 SQL、复现数据库问题、验证查询，以及试用任何受支持的数据库引擎。

支持的数据库引擎：PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQLite 等。

注意：使用此插件需要订阅 db-fiddle.com PRO。

payload.name: PayU Builder MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search PayU's official documentation, browse the payment integration catalog by platform and language, and fetch production-ready code snippets for Web, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Cordova, and API integrations. Supports 9 programming languages with ready-to-use examples for UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, EMI, and tokenization.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 PayU 官方文档，按平台和语言浏览支付集成目录，并获取适用于 Web、iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Cordova 和 API 集成的生产就绪代码片段。支持 9 种编程语言，提供 UPI、银行卡、网上银行、钱包、EMI 和令牌化的现成示例。

payload.name: DataBlue
payload.description: 面向 AI 智能体的实时网络数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Live web data for AI agents
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DataBlue is a live web data layer for AI agents. In ChatGPT, users can search the web, scrape one or many public pages, map and crawl websites, extract structured facts, and query DataBlue's catalog of structured data APIs.
payload.longDescription: DataBlue 是面向 AI 智能体的实时网络数据层。在 ChatGPT 中，用户可以搜索网络、抓取一个或多个公开页面、绘制网站结构并进行抓取、提取结构化事实，以及查询 DataBlue 的结构化数据 API 目录。

payload.name: Rubikpara
payload.description: Rubikpara 产品与 API 指南
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rubikpara’nın ödeme çözümlerini keşfedin; ürünler, API entegrasyonları, teknik dokümantasyon ve hata kodları hakkında ihtiyaç duyduğunuz resmi bilgilere yapay zekâ desteğiyle hızlı ve kolayca ulaşın.
payload.longDescription: 探索 Rubikpara 的支付解决方案；借助 AI 支持，快速轻松地获取产品、API 集成、技术文档和错误代码所需的官方信息。

payload.name: Appwrite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Appwrite's plugin helps users explore their projects, inspect databases and storage, and manage users, functions, messaging, and sites through ChatGPT. Discover available operations, review required parameters, and execute changes with write confirmation. Search official Appwrite documentation for concepts and implementation guidance when documentation search is enabled.
payload.longDescription: Appwrite 插件帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 探索项目、检查数据库和存储，以及管理用户、函数、消息和站点。发现可用操作、查看必填参数，并在写入确认后执行变更。启用文档搜索时，可搜索官方 Appwrite 文档，获取概念和实现指导。

payload.name: Postman
payload.description: 面向智能体的 API 工程工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Equip Codex with specialized Postman skills for the complete API lifecycle. Discover, design, test, document, mock, monitor, and improve APIs through agent-friendly, filesystem-first workflows
payload.longDescription: 为 Codex 配备 Postman 专业技能，覆盖完整的 API 生命周期。通过面向智能体、以文件系统为先的工作流，发现、设计、测试、记录、模拟、监控并改进 API。

payload.name: Unblocked
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, and Codex over MCP, or through the Unblocked CLI and API. Connects to GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Google Drive, Sentry, Datadog, and more.
payload.longDescription:
Unblocked 是智能体软件开发的上下文层。它会综合分析代码、对话、问题、文档、产品和生产系统，帮助智能体以更少的人工介入正确完成工作。

编程智能体了解代码，却不知道代码为何这样编写、两份冲突文档中哪一份是最新的、工单最终决定了什么，或生产环境当前正在发生什么。Unblocked 将分散在代码、消息平台、问题跟踪器、文档以及产品和生产数据中的上下文连接起来，协调不同来源间的冲突，并执行你已在各工具中设置的权限，从而让智能体获得这些组织层面的理解。

一个 MCP 服务器即可取代十几个服务器。上下文会先在服务器端进行排序、压缩和整理，再发送给智能体，让智能体能够基于更高质量的输入进行推理。最终生成的代码更加可靠，符合团队的实际开发方式，同时使用更少的 token，减少来回沟通。

可通过 MCP 与 Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、GitHub Copilot 和 Codex 配合使用，也可通过 Unblocked CLI 和 API 使用。可连接 GitHub、GitLab、Slack、Microsoft Teams、Jira、Linear、Confluence、Notion、Google Drive、Sentry、Datadog 等服务。

payload.name: Armature
payload.description: 查看 MCP 智能体活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Armature helps developers inspect configured MCP servers, review recorded agent sessions and use cases, investigate recurring issues, and report missing app capabilities through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Armature 帮助开发者通过 ChatGPT 查看已配置的 MCP 服务器、审查已记录的智能体会话和应用场景、调查反复出现的问题，并报告应用缺少的能力。

payload.name: Artie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Artie helps data teams set up, inspect, and operate change-data-capture pipelines from databases and APIs into warehouses. Use it to list pipelines and connectors, inspect table metadata, configure replication, monitor lag, and manage supporting infrastructure like SSH tunnels and PrivateLink connections—all within your authenticated Artie environment.
payload.longDescription: Artie帮助数据团队设置、查看和运行将数据库及API数据送入数据仓库的变更数据捕获管道。使用它列出管道和连接器、查看表元数据、配置复制、监控延迟，以及管理SSH隧道和PrivateLink连接等配套基础设施，全程在你已通过身份验证的Artie环境中完成。

payload.name: Gateway
payload.description: 通过 SSH 管理服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gateway lets users manage owned Linux and Windows OpenSSH servers from ChatGPT: inspect health and configuration, run auditable commands and typed administrative operations, transfer files, and follow durable jobs.
payload.longDescription: Gateway 让用户通过 ChatGPT 管理自己拥有的 Linux 和 Windows OpenSSH 服务器：检查运行状况和配置，运行可审计的命令及具有明确类型的管理操作，传输文件，并跟踪持久化任务。

payload.name: BoxToPlay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage your BoxToPlay game servers, VPS, and web hosting directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Manage Minecraft hosting, BungeeCord and Velocity proxies, TeamSpeak voice servers, VPS, and hosted websites from one place.

Depending on the service, you can:
• Monitor live service status, players, performance, health, and logs
• Investigate crashes, startup failures, and plugin, mod, or proxy issues using logs and health checks
• Manage files, settings, backups, firewall rules, and DNS records
• Start, stop, and restart services, and track long-running operations

Access is restricted to services in your authenticated BoxToPlay account and the permissions granted to the app.
payload.longDescription:
直接通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex 管理你的 BoxToPlay 游戏服务器、VPS和网站托管。

在同一个地方管理 Minecraft 托管、BungeeCord 和 Velocity 代理、TeamSpeak 语音服务器、VPS及托管网站。

根据不同服务，你可以：
• 监控实时服务状态、玩家、性能、健康状况和日志
• 使用日志和健康检查调查崩溃、启动失败，以及插件、模组或代理问题
• 管理文件、设置、备份、防火墙规则和DNS记录
• 启动、停止和重启服务，并跟踪长时间运行的操作

访问范围限于已认证的 BoxToPlay 账户中的服务，以及授予应用的权限。

payload.name: Rootly
payload.description: 使用 Rootly 管理事件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Rootly to investigate incidents, summarize alerts and timelines, review on-call schedules and escalation paths, and manage incident follow-up work.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到 Rootly，以调查事件、汇总警报和时间线、查看值班安排与升级路径，并管理事件后续工作。

payload.name: Data Dolphin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The DataDolphin connects ChatGPT to Dolphin Sistemas' structured knowledge base — including projects, documents, architecture rules, and agent instructions. With a single connection, you can query implementation context, retrieve project specifications, and access technical documentation in real time. All access is protected by OAuth 2.0 via Keycloak and restricted to read-only operations, ensuring safe and auditable use by AI agents.
payload.longDescription: DataDolphin 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Dolphin Sistemas 的结构化知识库，其中包括项目、文档、架构规则和智能体指令。只需一次连接，即可查询实现上下文、检索项目规格并实时访问技术文档。所有访问均通过 Keycloak 的 OAuth 2.0 保护，且仅限只读操作，确保 AI 智能体的使用安全且可审计。

payload.name: elmah.io MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: elmah.io MCP helps users inspect their elmah.io account from ChatGPT by listing accessible logs and organizations, analyzing recent and frequent log messages, reviewing deployments, checking uptime and heartbeat status, and retrieving detailed error context for debugging production issues.
payload.longDescription: elmah.io MCP 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中检查自己的 elmah.io 账户，包括列出可访问的日志和组织、分析近期及频繁出现的日志消息、查看部署、检查可用性和心跳状态，以及获取用于调试生产问题的详细错误背景。

payload.name: Strix
payload.description: AI 渗透测试与漏洞分诊
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Strix brings AI penetration testing and vulnerability management into ChatGPT. Review recent tests, prioritize open findings by severity, and inspect evidence and remediation steps. Start tests against your authorized web applications, APIs, and repositories; retest findings; and open fix pull requests or tickets through connected integrations. Check pull request security reviews and supply-chain findings, manage recurring schedules and assets, and summarize your workspace's security activity. Sign in with your Strix account using OAuth. Access follows your Strix workspace role and resource permissions. Starting tests, retests, reviews, and other security workflows may use Strix credits and send traffic to the selected targets. Some capabilities require an eligible Strix plan.
payload.longDescription: Strix 将 AI 渗透测试和漏洞管理引入 ChatGPT。查看近期测试，按严重程度排列未解决的发现，并检查证据和修复步骤。针对你获准测试的 Web 应用、API 和代码库启动测试；重新测试发现的问题；并通过已连接的集成创建修复拉取请求或工单。检查拉取请求的安全审查和供应链发现，管理定期计划和资产，并总结工作区的安全活动。使用 Strix 账户通过 OAuth 登录。访问权限遵循你在 Strix 工作区中的角色和资源权限。启动测试、重新测试、审查及其他安全工作流可能会消耗 Strix 额度，并向所选目标发送流量。部分功能需要符合条件的 Strix 方案。

payload.name: QtMesh Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: QtMesh Cloud helps users inspect 3D asset quality from ChatGPT. Users can list their projects, review scan summaries, inspect findings and scan reports, check quality gate settings, update owner-scoped quality gates, and control whether a project's public report is visible.
payload.longDescription: QtMesh Cloud 可帮助用户直接从 ChatGPT 检查 3D 资源质量。用户可以列出项目、查看扫描摘要、检查发现的问题和扫描报告、查看质量门设置、更新所有者范围内的质量门，并控制项目公开报告是否可见。

payload.name: Openlayer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Openlayer helps teams inspect AI projects, data sources, traces, tests, evaluation results, and governance controls, and manage private workspace resources through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Openlayer 帮助团队通过 ChatGPT 检查 AI 项目、数据源、追踪记录、测试、评估结果和治理控制，并管理私有工作区资源。

payload.name: Unbounce - Classic Builder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Unbounce account to create and edit landing pages, add A/B test variants, set traffic splits, and check page performance without leaving the chat. 
Describe the page you want and Unbounce will build it; ask for a new variant, a headline change, or a conversion report and it's handled in your account.
Works with your existing Unbounce pages, domains, and page groups. Requires an Unbounce account and the Classic Builder.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Unbounce 账户，即可在聊天中创建和编辑着陆页、添加 A/B 测试变体、设置流量分配并查看页面效果。
描述你想要的页面，Unbounce 就会为你构建；你也可以要求创建新变体、修改标题或生成转化报告，相关操作会在你的账户中完成。
可与现有 Unbounce 页面、域名和页面组配合使用。需要 Unbounce 账户及 Classic Builder。

payload.name: Greptile
payload.description: 审查代码与 PR 反馈
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AI code review agent for GitHub and GitLab. View Greptile's PR review comments, run reviews on your working branch, and search your organization's knowledge base and coding patterns, directly from Codex.
payload.longDescription: 面向 GitHub 和 GitLab 的 AI 代码审查代理。直接在 Codex 中查看 Greptile 的 PR 审查评论、审查当前工作分支，并搜索组织的知识库和编码模式。

payload.name: Embrasure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Embrasure helps ChatGPT and Codex investigate silent data failures without querying arbitrary warehouse rows. Inspect table health and Scout evidence, trace table- and column-level lineage, identify downstream services and owners, and understand blast radius before a change. Reads respect workspace permissions. Scout changes always require preview and explicit approval.
payload.longDescription: Embrasure帮助ChatGPT和Codex在不查询任意仓库行的情况下调查静默数据故障。检查表健康状态并侦察证据，追踪表级和列级数据血统，识别下游服务及负责人，了解变更前的影响范围。读取操作会尊重工作区权限。Scout更改始终需要预览和明确审批。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Data warehouse setup, Source connections and sync, SQL queries, Charts and dashboards, Shared business definitions

payload.name: SCVD x402 Verifier
payload.description: 检查 x402 支付门槛和回执
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SCVD x402 Verifier checks payment challenges without paying, verifies signed x402 offers and receipts, reads recorded endpoint readiness, explains defect classes, and checks SCVD artifact signatures. Results describe evidence and limits; they do not establish delivery or guarantee a provider. All tools are free and no wallet or login is required. Calls record usage statistics. Readiness lookups for eligible hosts with no recorded probe add the hostname and ask count to a public queue for a later discovery sweep; caller identity is not included in that queue.
payload.longDescription: SCVD x402 Verifier 无需付款即可检查支付挑战、验证已签名的 x402 报价和回执、读取已记录的端点就绪状态、解释缺陷类别，并检查 SCVD 工件签名。结果说明证据及其局限；它们不能证明已交付，也不保证服务提供方。所有工具均免费，无需钱包或登录。调用会记录使用统计。对于尚无探测记录的符合条件主机，就绪状态查询会将主机名和查询次数加入公开队列，供后续发现扫描使用；队列中不包含调用者身份。

payload.name: Limrun
payload.description: 在云模拟器上测试应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Limrun gives your agent iOS simulators and Android emulators in the cloud. Ask for a device and it is ready in seconds, with your app pre-installed if you want.
payload.longDescription: Limrun 为你的智能体提供云端 iOS 模拟器和 Android 模拟器。只需提出所需设备，几秒钟内即可就绪；你还可以选择预先安装自己的应用。

payload.name: qBraid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: qBraid helps users explore quantum devices, validate and simulate circuits, submit quantum jobs, and inspect results. Users can manage cloud compute, inspect notebooks and software environments, browse qBook courses, enroll in courses, and review learner progress when authorized. It also supports organization membership and credit workflows, billing summaries, and support requests. Credit purchases and course creation or redeployment are unavailable through this app. Some actions spend existing credits, change access, or send messages, and support content can be shared with support services.
payload.longDescription: qBraid 可帮助用户探索量子设备、验证和模拟电路、提交量子作业并检查结果。经授权后，用户还可以管理云计算资源、检查笔记本和软件环境、浏览 qBook 课程、报名课程并查看学习进度。它还支持组织成员管理和额度工作流、账单摘要及支持请求。此应用无法购买额度，也无法创建或重新部署课程。某些操作会消耗现有额度、更改访问权限或发送消息；支持内容可能会分享给支持服务提供方。

payload.name: LabWired
payload.description: 在虚拟芯片上运行固件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: LabWired runs real embedded firmware on a deterministic simulation of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M, RISC-V, and ESP32), right inside the conversation. Pick a board, wire up an MCU with sensors, displays, and buses, compile firmware, and run it in an interactive hardware lab you can watch — no physical board required. The same firmware binary that flashes to real silicon runs in the simulator, so results are reproducible enough to debug and to gate CI on. LabWired validates your wiring before it runs, lists the boards and components it supports, compiles firmware from source, and opens a live lab view embedded in ChatGPT where you can see GPIO, serial output, and peripherals respond in real time.
payload.longDescription: LabWired 可在微控制器（ARM Cortex-M、RISC-V 和 ESP32）的确定性仿真环境中运行真实嵌入式固件，整个过程都在对话中完成。选择开发板，为 MCU 连接传感器、显示屏和总线，编译固件，并在交互式硬件实验室中运行和观察——无需实体开发板。烧录到真实芯片上的固件二进制文件也能在模拟器中运行，因此结果可重复，足以用于调试和 CI 门禁检查。LabWired 会在运行前验证接线，列出支持的开发板和组件，从源代码编译固件，并在 ChatGPT 中打开嵌入式实时实验室视图，让你实时观察 GPIO、串口输出和外设的响应。

payload.name: Better Design
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
When ChatGPT builds you an app, a website or a page, it often looks generic and misses how people will use it. Better Design is a design harness that helps ChatGPT get both right.

Pick a look. Describe your product, and Better Design shows you design systems that fit it, such as calm and trustworthy for a finance app. A design system is the set of colors, fonts, buttons and cards that makes a product look like one brand. You choose one, and ChatGPT builds with it.

Make your own. Describe the feel you want, or share your website, and Better Design creates a custom design system in a few minutes.

Get the experience right. Better Design tells ChatGPT how sign-up, onboarding, forms, search, checkout and error messages should work, and what each screen should say.

Check the result. Better Design reviews what ChatGPT built for the problems people notice: text that is hard to read, buttons that are hard to find, screens that ask for too much at once, and words only insiders understand.
payload.longDescription:
当ChatGPT为你构建应用、网站或页面时，往往显得过于普通，未能体现实际使用场景。
Better Design是一个设计工具，能帮助ChatGPT同时实现外观与体验的精准呈现。

选择外观。
描述你的产品特性，Better Design会展示适配的设计系统，例如为金融类应用提供平静可信的视觉风格。
设计系统包含颜色、字体、按钮和卡片等元素，这些构成了产品的品牌视觉特征。
你可以任选其一，ChatGPT将基于该系统进行开发。

自定义设计。
描述你期望的视觉感受，或上传现有网站，Better Design将在数分钟内生成定制化设计系统。

优化使用体验。
Better Design会指导ChatGPT如何设计注册流程、引导机制、表单交互、搜索功能、结账流程和错误提示，以及每个界面的具体文案。

验证最终效果。
Better Design会检查ChatGPT生成内容是否符合用户常见关注点：难以阅读的文字、难以发现的按钮、一次性要求过多信息的界面，以及仅内部人员理解的术语。

payload.name: Tiniest Cloud
payload.description: 部署带登录功能的 Web 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tiniest Cloud hosts static web apps and gives each one sign-in, per-user storage, realtime, push notifications, scheduled jobs and a language model with nothing to configure. From a conversation you can deploy a folder and get a live URL, share the app with someone by email, roll back to an earlier version, connect a third-party API without putting its key in the page, schedule recurring work, and put an app on your own domain.
payload.longDescription: Tiniest Cloud 可托管静态 Web 应用，并为每个应用提供登录、用户级存储、实时功能、推送通知、定时任务和语言模型，无需任何配置。你可以在对话中部署一个文件夹并获得在线 URL，通过电子邮件与他人共享应用，将应用回滚到早期版本，在不把密钥放进页面的情况下连接第三方 API，安排周期性工作，并将应用部署到自己的域名。

payload.name: AiAkiv Memory
payload.description: AI 智能体的共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AiAkiv is long-term memory that AI agents and teammates share over MCP. It saves the important parts of your conversations as a knowledge graph and recalls them across sessions, tools, and teammates — so context one AI saves, the next one picks up, and a whole team works from one shared memory instead of scattered private chats. Save with an explicit command ("ak save"), recall by meaning with semantic search. Hosted remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; Korean and English supported.
payload.longDescription: AiAkiv 是 AI 智能体与团队成员通过 MCP 共享的长期记忆。它将对话中的重要部分保存为知识图谱，并在不同会话、工具和团队成员之间回忆这些内容——一个 AI 保存的上下文，另一个 AI 就能接续使用，整个团队基于同一份共享记忆工作，而非依靠分散的私人聊天。通过明确指令（“ak save”）保存，使用语义搜索按含义回忆。采用托管的远程 MCP 服务器和 OAuth 登录；支持韩语和英语。

payload.name: Tessryx
payload.description: 构建并托管在线 Web 应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Build and host live web apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tessryx gives an agent somewhere to build. From chat, it creates the data, logic, pages and scheduled jobs for a real website, API or internal tool, and Tessryx hosts them at a public URL on the user's own domain. No code is generated for the user to deploy and nothing needs to be run locally.

The main workflows the tools support:
- Author a JSON Schema, then datafiles validated against it. The same schema generates an editing interface, so a non-technical person can maintain the content afterwards without an agent.
- Author workflows that return HTML or JSON, and bind them to public URLs as dynamic endpoints with edge caching. One endpoint serves both a rendered page and the API routes that page's own JavaScript calls.
- Define parameterized HTTP calls to external systems, with credentials held as write-only secrets the assistant can reference but never read.
- Schedule workflows on a cron or interval so data recomputes on its own.
- Claim and verify a custom domain and serve any of the above from it.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1; there are no API keys for the user to manage.
payload.longDescription:
Tessryx 为智能体提供构建空间。它可以在聊天中创建真实网站、API 或内部工具所需的数据、逻辑、页面和定时任务，并将其托管在用户自己域名的公开 URL 上。用户无需部署生成的代码，也无需在本地运行任何程序。

工具支持的主要工作流：
- 编写 JSON Schema，再创建通过该架构验证的数据文件。同一架构还会生成编辑界面，让非技术人员之后无需智能体也能维护内容。
- 编写可返回 HTML 或 JSON 的工作流，并将其绑定到带边缘缓存的公开动态端点。一个端点同时提供渲染页面，以及该页面自身 JavaScript 调用的 API 路由。
- 定义带参数的外部系统 HTTP 调用，凭据以只写密钥的形式保存，助手可以引用但无法读取。
- 按 cron 或时间间隔安排工作流，使数据自动重新计算。
- 认领并验证自定义域名，并通过该域名提供上述任意内容。

身份验证采用 OAuth 2.1；用户无需管理 API 密钥。

payload.name: Tuist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tuist helps teams inspect Xcode, Gradle, and Bazel build data, test results, cache activity, previews, runner jobs, and project configuration. It also supports authorized account setup and selected test-case updates.
payload.longDescription: Tuist 帮助团队检查 Xcode、Gradle 和 Bazel 构建数据、测试结果、缓存活动、预览、运行器作业及项目配置。它还支持经授权的账户设置和部分测试用例更新。

payload.name: Better Stack
payload.description: 为 AI 智能体提供可观测性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Observability for AI agents: query your logs, traces, metrics, and errors with SQL, build dashboards and chart alerts, manage uptime monitors, respond to incidents, see who's on-call, and publish status page reports. You can also create and link error issues in Linear or Jira and search Better Stack's docs without leaving the chat. Connects to your Better Stack account.
payload.longDescription: 为 AI 智能体提供可观测性：通过 SQL 查询日志、追踪、指标和错误，构建控制面板和图表告警，管理可用性监控，响应事件，查看值班人员，并发布状态页报告。你还可以在 Linear 或 Jira 中创建和关联错误问题，并搜索 Better Stack 文档，无需离开聊天。连接到你的 Better Stack 账号。

payload.name: RepoLore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RepoLore helps developers understand why public GitHub code exists by tracing files and line ranges through commits, pull requests, issues, patches, and regression evidence.
payload.longDescription: RepoLore 帮助开发者了解公开 GitHub 代码存在的原因，方法是沿着提交、拉取请求、问题、补丁和回归证据追踪文件及代码行范围。

payload.name: LaunchDarkly
payload.description: 功能开关、AI 配置和指标

Works alongside the Termalin desktop app (Windows/macOS/Linux) and web cabinet, but needs neither to be open.

To get started you need a termal.in account (Pro, Team or trial) with at least one Connector enrolled (Settings → Connectors, a one-line install) and a verified email.

payload.name: doDomain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.
payload.longDescription:
doDomain 是一种“域名连接即服务”：它为产品提供引导式流程，让客户将自己的域名指向该产品，并负责处理背后的 DNS 记录、验证和证书。doDomain 插件可让 ChatGPT 通过你的账户处理这些工作：检查域名当前的 DNS 状态、列出团队配置的应用、列出已有域名连接、为客户创建新的连接会话、查询已启动的会话、在记录就绪后验证会话，以及对已发生漂移的连接重新运行验证。

访问通过 OAuth 2.1、PKCE 和动态客户端注册进行。用户可在授权同意界面按功能授予范围——域名、应用、连接和会话各自有独立的读写范围；对于未获授权的范围，助手不会获得相应工具。可随时在仪表板的 Connected Apps 页面撤销已连接应用。工具响应遵循严格限定的契约：绝不会返回秘密 API 密钥，而且插件完全无法访问 doDomain 的计费功能。

创建连接会话会计入套餐每月连接配额；验证检查受速率限制，因此同一连接重复验证时，系统会提示等待，而不会悄悄重试。
